text: Isn't it a shame? You proved it. Isn't it a shame? You knew it wasn't like a man the way you said goodbye. Just like clay pigeons shooting with a skeet gun, you missed one. Throw them up again into the air. Spending every day since the day you left me while you're running around trying to forget me down.
